batch.description: Jahangirnagar University H Unit (Institute of Information Technology / Mathematical & Physical Sciences stream), academic session 2016-2017, Set-3 — full 80-question paper transcribed by direct visual reading (with zoomed crops) of Part 2 of the Udvash 'জাবি প্রশ্নব্যাংক' (JU A & D Unit question bank), book PDF pp.278-287 (printed pp.93-102). NEWLY DISCOVERED PAPER: this paper does not appear in BOOK_MAP_FULL.md at all — the map's span for H 2016-2017 Set-1 wrongly absorbed these pages; the paper was identified from its own printed header on book PDF p.278 (জাবি ভর্তি পরীক্ষা ২০১৬-২০১৭ শিক্ষাবর্ষ, পূর্ণমান: ৮০, ইউনিট-H, সেট-3, সময়: ১:০০ ঘণ্টা) under the page banner 'প্রশ্ন-সমাধান: ২০১৬-১৭'. Part 2 has NO answer table: each question carries its key inline, as an '[Ans: x]' tag and/or a printed worked solution ('সমাধান:'/'Solution:'); no question carries both forms in this paper, and the two forms therefore never disagree — one internal inconsistency does occur inside a single printed solution (Q14, below). EXTRACTION STAGE: all questions are marked content-UNVERIFIED and all keyed answers answer-UNVERIFIED — the printed publisher answer keys are preserved as-is and are NOT official JU keys; cross-source verification is a later stage. The paper is printed in THREE syllabus tiers whose question numbers interlock: the 'Short Syllabus' run (banner on book PDF p.278) carries 54 questions, the 'Extra Syllabus' block (heading at the foot of book PDF p.284, continuing on pp.285-287) carries 25, and a single-question 'Old Syllabus' block (heading on book PDF p.287) carries Q41; together they partition the printed numbers 1-80 exactly once, and each question's tier is recorded in its topic field. Short: Q1-22, 29-35, 37-40, 42-48, 50, 52, 53, 59, 65, 66, 70-75, 78, 80. Extra: Q23-28, 36, 49, 51, 54-58, 60-64, 67-69, 76, 77, 79. Old: Q41. The book prints no per-subject headings; subject blocks follow the printed question-number ranges, confirmed by content: Bangla Q1-5, English Q6-20, Physics Q21-40, Higher Mathematics Q41-80 — counts Bangla 5, English 15, Physics 20, Higher Mathematics 40. Question numbers are NOT printed in numeric order across the pages: p.278 carries Q1-12; p.279 carries Q13-22, 29-32; p.280 carries Q33-35, 37-40, 42; p.281 carries Q43-46; p.282 carries Q47, 48, 50, 52, 53; p.283 carries Q59, 65, 66, 70-73; p.284 carries Q74, 75, 78, 80 and (Extra Syllabus) Q23-26; p.285 carries (Extra Syllabus) Q27, 28, 36, 49, 51, 54-56; p.286 carries (Extra Syllabus) Q57, 58, 60-64, 67; p.287 carries (Extra Syllabus) Q68, 69, 76, 77, 79 and (Old Syllabus) Q41. Keys: 74 keyed single_choice, 0 dual keys, 0 keyless, and exactly SIX printed no-correct-option dispositions — Q62 ('সমাধান: (No Answer)'), Q70, Q71, Q75, Q77 and Q80 (each 'সমাধান: (সঠিক উত্তর নেই)'); those six carry answerDisposition 'no_correct_option' with correctOptionIds [] and answerVerificationStatus 'verified' solely because the validator requires that status for a no_correct_option disposition — it records the book's own printed claim (the printed solution's no-answer statement), not cross-source verification — while their contentVerificationStatus remains 'unverified' like every other question in this extraction-stage pack. Preserved print anomalies: Q14's printed solution is headed '(d)' while its own gloss says 'অবহেলা করা (ignore)', i.e. option (a) — the head key (d) is recorded and the inconsistency flagged; Q74's printed solution is headed '(a)' but derives θ = nπ ± π/6, which matches no printed option verbatim (option (a) prints 'nπ + π/6' with no ±); Q6's stem prints 'When I am not in hurry' (no article); Q7's stem prints 'adjective from of the noun'; Q11's printed tag keys (b) 'No business-like' for the idiom 'bad business'; Q19's options (a)-(c) print as incomplete fragments; Q35's options print as bare numbers with no unit; Q47's stem says 'অঙ্কিত লম্বের দৈর্ঘ্য' where the book's own printed note corrects it to the tangent ('স্পর্শকের দৈর্ঘ্য'); Q50(c) opens with a brace but closes with a parenthesis, and Q50's solution heading prints a doubled parenthesis 'সমাধান:( (b);'; Q58(c) prints no numeral after ‘ক’; Q62's stem prints set A without the absolute-value bars its solution assumes; Q66's stem prints 'x^3 - 3x + 4x - 3' (no ^2 on the second term) against its solution's 'x^3 - 3x^2 + 4x - 3'; Q69's stem prints asterisks for multiplication; Q78(b) prints '7.3'; Q41's content is Physics although its printed number places it in the Higher Mathematics block. No question in this paper carries a figure or diagram of its own; diagrams appear only inside printed worked solutions (Q43, Q46, Q48, Q59, Q70, Q73, Q75). BOUNDARY NOTE: book PDF p.277 belongs to the PREVIOUS paper (H 2016-2017 Set-1) and book PDF p.288 opens the NEXT paper (H 2015-2016 Set-4); nothing outside book PDF pp.278-287 is included in this pack. [UNVERIFIED import-format edition: only the questions that did NOT pass cross-source verification, with true statuses preserved; see Admission-Unverified-Import/README.md.]

sourceDocuments.notes: Publisher question-bank book (Udvash Academic & Admission Care), scanned PDF, 295 pp. The book's Part 2 (typeset প্রশ্ন-সমাধান section, banner 'প্রশ্ন-সমাধান: ২০১৬-১৭') restarts pagination: printed page = book PDF page - 185. Set-3 of JU H Unit 2016-2017 occupies printed pp.93-102 = book PDF pp.278-287: 'Short Syllabus' run on pp.278-284 (banner on p.278), the 'Extra Syllabus' block beginning at the foot of printed p.99 (book PDF p.284) and continuing on printed pp.100-102 (book PDF pp.285-287), and a one-question 'Old Syllabus' block at the foot of printed p.102 (book PDF p.287). This paper is newly discovered: it does not appear in BOOK_MAP_FULL.md, whose span for H 2016-2017 Set-1 wrongly absorbed these pages. There is no answer table in Part 2; keys are inline ('[Ans: x]' tags and printed 'সমাধান:'/'Solution:' worked solutions printed directly under each question). Paper header (book PDF p.278) confirmed before transcription: জাবি ভর্তি পরীক্ষা ২০১৬-২০১৭ শিক্ষাবর্ষ, পূর্ণমান: ৮০, ইউনিট-H, সেট-3, সময়: ১:০০ ঘণ্টা. The previous paper (H 2016-2017 Set-1) ends on book PDF p.277 and the following paper (H 2015-2016 Set-4) begins on book PDF p.288. Transcription by direct visual reading of every page image at 300 dpi, with zoomed re-reads (PIL crops) for Q1-Q3, Q6-Q11, Q13-Q22, Q23-Q32, Q33-Q40, Q42-Q58, Q59-Q80 and all tier headings. Mathematical notation linearised (^ for superscripts, a/b for fractions, √, π, matrices wrapped in [...] with rows separated by ';', unit vectors as î, ĵ, k̂ and vector arrows as →; chemical-style subscripts in symbols such as f_o, f_e, v_E and c_32 written with an underscore).
